summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, notifying a change in the news portal webpage used for disclosure of material acts and facts. The company replaced its prior portal with https://mzgroup.com.br/fatos-relevantes/ and resubmitted its Registration Form and Policy for Disclosure of Material Acts. This is an administrative update with no financial terms, transaction structure, or event affecting shareholders. No price, premium, recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. This filing carries no event-driven or special-situations characteristics; it is purely a change in disclosure logistics. There is nothing to watch from a risk-arb or special-situations perspective.
